datasets.name: ds_grand_total
queryLines:
WITH project_jobs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT job_id
  FROM system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE name LIKE '[%] %'
),
project_pipelines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pipeline_id, name AS pipeline_name
  FROM system.lakeflow.pipelines
  WHERE name LIKE '[%] %'
),
job_usage AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(u.usage_metadata.job_name, 'Unnamed job run') AS component,
    u.usage_date,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_quantity
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  JOIN project_jobs pj ON u.usage_metadata.job_id = pj.job_id
),
pipeline_usage AS (
  SELECT
    pp.pipeline_name AS component,
    u.usage_date,
    u.sku_name,
    u.usage_quantity
  FROM system.billing.usage u
  JOIN project_pipelines pp ON u.usage_metadata.dlt_pipeline_id = pp.pipeline_id
),
combined AS (
  SELECT * FROM job_usage
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM pipeline_usage
),
labeled AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN component LIKE '%Data Chunking%' THEN 'Chunking'
      WHEN component LIKE '%COPY INTO%' OR component LIKE '%Bronze DLT%' OR component LIKE '%Bronze Auto Loader%' THEN 'Bronze'
      WHEN component LIKE '%Silver%' THEN 'Silver'
      WHEN component LIKE '%Gold%' THEN 'Gold'
      WHEN component LIKE '%Medallion Pipeline%' THEN 'Orchestration'
      ELSE 'Other'
    END AS layer,
    component,
    usage_date,
    sku_name,
    usage_quantity
  FROM combined
)
SELECT SUM(usage_quantity) AS total_dbu FROM labeled

lines: # VStone Medallion Pipeline â€” Resource Usage

Real DBU consumption from `system.billing.usage`, joined against `system.lakeflow.jobs` / `system.lakeflow.pipelines` and scoped to this project's bundle-deployed resources only (name-prefix `[<target> <user>]`) â€” ad-hoc scratch/verification job runs and unrelated workspace activity are excluded. Silver and Gold layer compute is billed under `dlt_pipeline_id`, not `job_id`, so both attribution paths are unioned below; a job-name-only view would have missed roughly two-thirds of real project DBU. All project usage on this Free Edition workspace currently falls under a single SKU (serverless jobs compute) â€” there is no cluster/warehouse-type variety to break out further.
